layout.arrangement: Title centered horizontally in the upper-middle area; subtitle centered directly beneath the title; yellow slide-number circle in the top-right corner; thin red rectangular border framing the entire slide; small notification text in the bottom-left corner.
layout.hierarchy: Title dominates via large bold red type; subtitle is secondary in smaller italic blue; the yellow circle is a small high-contrast accent; the border and notification are minor framing/overlay elements.

visual_elements.description: Thin red rectangular border outlining the slide content area
Small yellow-filled circle with a thin dark outline containing the numeral 6

typography_notes: Sans-serif typeface throughout. Title is bold, large, and red. Subtitle is italic, medium-sized, and blue. The slide number is small black text inside a yellow circle. The bottom-left notification is very small, light gray or black sans-serif.
animation_state: None; static slide with no visible build stages.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a slide with a light gray background (#F0F0F0). 2. Draw a thin red rectangle border (#FF0000) around the slide edges. 3. Insert a centered text box in the upper-middle area with the text 'Problems of Linear Regression' in bold red (#C00000) sans-serif, approximately 40pt. 4. Insert a second centered text box directly below the first with '(With Linearly Separable Data)' in italic blue (#0000FF) sans-serif, approximately 28pt. 5. Add a small yellow circle (#FFFF00) with a thin black outline in the top-right corner and place the number '6' inside it in small black text. 6. Add a tiny text box in the bottom-left corner reading 'ument has just been saved.' in small gray/black sans-serif.
